title: Low degree Fourier coefficient bound
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $0<\delta\leq 1$. If the expected value, over the random restriction, of $2$ raised to the restricted function’s decision tree depth is at most $2$, then the sum of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of size at most $k$ is at most $2\delta^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
the expected value under the specified random restriction of $2$ to the restricted decision tree depth is at most $2$
